en.askTitle: Swap in your own kiosk plan and get the same slow-sales funding check before you sign anything
en.runTitle: A first coffee kiosk in Manchester: 15 m², takeaway only, opening 1 March 2027

fields.label: Site and opening date
fields.value: a 15 m² takeaway-only kiosk in Manchester, UK, opening 1 March 2027

fields.label: Currency and funding
fields.placeholder: e.g. pounds, £30,000 of my own savings

fields.label: Ticket and demand
fields.placeholder: e.g. £4.20 a cup, 120 cups a day once established

fields.label: My work and drawings
fields.placeholder: e.g. I work 40 hours a week and draw £1,500 a month

fields.label: Lease and supplier quotes
fields.placeholder: e.g. £1,200 a month rent, espresso machine quote £6,000

en.template: Plan my coffee-kiosk budget for {site}, with {funding}, {demand}, {staff}, {drawings} and {quotes}. Lead with slow-sales funding, the lowest usable cash and any gap. Separate profit, cash after drawings and start-up recovery; flag tax, VAT, payroll and deposit assumptions. Show what to confirm before signing. Plan only; do not contact suppliers, apply, pay or publish.

phases.title: Check UK pay, tax and card-fee rules and set clear planning assumptions
phases.note: Minimum wage from April 2027, employer costs, VAT and card fees

phases.title: Build the formula-driven budget and three sales scenarios
phases.note: Start-up costs, 12-month profit and cash, plus Manchester registration, street-trading, rates, insurance and pension rules
phases.judgment: It would not assume the kiosk escapes street-trading rules just because it sits on private land. The £500 permit allowance is labelled as an unsourced placeholder, with a note that Manchester’s published fee can be £720, and the site’s status is left as an open question.

phases.title: Recalculate, test edits and deliver the summary and sources
phases.judgment: An independent colleague found three real faults in the workbook: units shown as pounds, the average ticket added up across months, and zero demand showing a break-even of zero cups a day. All three were fixed and retested. Zero demand now says “not achievable”, and the final check ran 226 tests with no formula errors.

workers: Read the official UK and Manchester rules for a small fixed kiosk: food registration, street trading, business rates, insurance, holiday pay, pensions and employer costs
Independently audited the finished workbook: followed the formulas and assumptions through and tried edge cases such as zero demand

zh.askTitle: 把你自己的咖啡亭方案填进去，签约前先做一遍同样的低销量资金检查
zh.runTitle: 曼彻斯特第一家咖啡亭：约 15 平方米，只做外带，2027 年 3 月 1 日开业

fields.label: 地点和开业日期
fields.value: 英国曼彻斯特，约 15 平方米、只做外带的咖啡亭，2027 年 3 月 1 日开业

fields.label: 币种和资金
fields.placeholder: 例如：英镑，自有积蓄 3 万英镑

fields.label: 客单价和需求
fields.placeholder: 例如：每杯 4.2 英镑，稳定后每天卖 120 杯

fields.label: 员工年龄和工时
fields.value: 1 位店主加 2 位兼职员工

fields.label: 我的劳动和提款
fields.placeholder: 例如：我每周干 40 小时，每月提款 1,500 英镑

fields.label: 租约及供应商报价
fields.placeholder: 例如：月租 1,200 英镑，咖啡机报价 6,000 英镑

zh.template: 请按{site}、{funding}、{demand}、{staff}、{drawings}、{quotes}，帮我算咖啡亭预算。先看低销量时要备多少钱、最低可用现金及缺口。分清利润、提款后现金和回本；提醒我税款、VAT、工资和押金有哪些假设，以及签约前要问清什么。只做计划，不联系供应商、不申请、不付款、不发布。

phases.title: 查英国最低工资、税费和刷卡手续费规则，定下清楚的测算假设
phases.note: 2027 年 4 月起的最低工资、雇主成本、增值税和刷卡费

phases.title: 搭好用公式驱动的预算表和三种销量情景
phases.note: 开业前花费、12 个月利润和现金，以及曼彻斯特的食品登记、街头经营、营业房产税、保险和养老金规则
phases.judgment: 它没有因为咖啡亭在私人土地上，就默认可以免受街头经营管理。许可费的 500 英镑预留金明确标成没有来源的占位数，并注明曼彻斯特公布的费用可能是 720 英镑；选址性质也留作待确认的问题。

phases.title: 重新计算、试改数据，交付摘要和来源
phases.judgment: 一位独立同事在表格里找出三处真问题：单位被显示成英镑、平均客单价被按月份加总、需求为零时盈亏平衡显示成每天 0 杯。三处都已改正并重新测试，需求为零时现在显示“无法实现”；最后一轮跑了 226 项核对，公式零错误。

workers: 查英国和曼彻斯特对小型固定咖啡亭的官方规定：食品登记、街头经营、营业房产税、保险、带薪假、养老金和雇主成本
独立复核做好的表格：沿着公式和假设逐项追下去，并试了需求为零等极端情况
